name: De'Longhi Mica Panel Heater HMP1500
summary: A fanless micathermic panel that heats silently, so it's the one to run while you sleep or work in the same room. Reviewed and Bob Vila both measured it warming a room steadily, and Bob Vila confirmed its tip-over switch. The front panel gets hot, it's 27 in wide on its feet, and De'Longhi doesn't publish its warranty term on the product page.
idealFor: Anyone who wants silent heat in the room where they sleep
Renters who can wall-mount it, or have a free stretch of wall to stand it against
pros: No fan, so no fan noise
Raised Reviewed's 1,350 cu ft test room by 6°F in an hour; Reviewed's overall pick
Raised Bob Vila's 156 sq ft room by 5°F in 18 minutes
Low setting at 750 W, wall bracket included
cons: The front panel gets hot; Bob Vila advises wall-mounting it out of reach of small children
27.4 × 9.8 in on its feet, the biggest footprint here
Its thermostat has no set temperature in degrees
Warranty term not stated on De'Longhi's product page

trust.summary: Two independent tests agree it heats a room steadily, and De'Longhi has no CPSC recall in the last five years. De'Longhi gives a US address and has held its US trademark since 1982. It loses points because we couldn't verify a UL or ETL listing, the page lists no weight or materials, and we couldn't find this heater's warranty term or claim process.
